processing_rules: All source row order retained; no sorting by DeltaK, interpolation, smoothing, or clipping.
Original units retained beside SI conversions: mm to m is 1e-3, kN to N is 1e3, MPa sqrt(m) to Pa sqrt(m) is 1e6.
Author-derived growth rates are not raw instantaneous events. Crack-history and derived-rate views of the same experiment are correlated.
Negative measured increments retained and flagged; not interpreted as physical crack healing.
No author model predictions or secondary-material reference data enter primary calibration files.
Unknown parameters remain null. No default 300 K, 1000 Hz, absolute source-coordinate offset, closure correction, or forced Paris exponent.
Full dataset, source workbooks, partial pairs, duplicates, and outlier all preserved.
